instructions: Compare the human review messages with the before and after text for the changed section. Choose resolved in spirit only when the revised text implements what the human asked for. Choose unrelated when the section changed without addressing the request. Agent replies do not establish the request.

labels.name: resolved in spirit
labels.description: The revised text does what the human comment asked, even if the wording or structure changed.

input.comment: Please enable retry after a timeout.
input.before: The revised section does not yet enable retry.
input.after: The revised section enables retry after a timeout and records the retry.

input.comment: Please keep this passage attached after the move.
input.before: The server retries once on timeout and keeps the original comment quote.
input.after: Move comment here resolves the orphaned thread and starts a new draft comment at the suggested section that quotes the original, using only existing events; the agent answers it like any comment.

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: The revised text does not address the human comment, even though the section changed.

input.before: The revised section had the old cache rule.
input.after: The revised section changes only the display color of the badge.

input.before: The flow figure shows the request path.
input.after: The flow figure boxes are wider and a label moved.
